data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 0.5 million for the 2015 calendar year, primarily due to favorable claims development and a reduction in prior years' reserves for catastrophe losses, as indicated by the claims development triangle. The report also noted a net surplus of GBP 2.4 million from the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. The 2013 underwriting year result improved by GBP 1.3 million due to a reduction in prior years' reserves for catastrophe losses. During 2015, the syndicate incurred limited losses from the Tianjin explosions, Southern India floods, and UK storms and flooding.
